consumer.use: Decide whether an offline, shadow-only routing model pilot has sufficiently complete and independently reviewable training labels to begin model comparison.

decision_target.question: Can evidence-bound shadow capture produce a trustworthy route-plus-outcome cohort without treating process state as task correctness or granting ML operational authority?

intervention.name: evidence-bound shadow route/outcome capture
intervention.description: For naturally occurring eligible coding-agent tasks, record canonical route identity, bounded task-class features and an independently reviewed semantic outcome after execution; the record never changes the selected route.

control_condition.description: Use current Grabowski task records and lifecycle receipts only. Route identity may be inferable from argv in some cases; terminal state is not treated as semantic correctness.

treatment_condition.description: Use the same natural task flow plus one proposal-only shadow observation binding canonical route identity to independent semantic outcome evidence after the task.

measurement.method: Compute the share of eligible cohort cases containing both canonical route identity and an independently reviewed semantic outcome label with evidence references; inferred argv labels and process-only states do not count.
measurement.success: At least 90 percent completeness across at least 20 natural eligible treatment cases, with zero automatic routing effects and no raw transcript capture.
measurement.falsification: Below 80 percent completeness, unresolved reviewer leakage, process-state substitution for semantic correctness, raw private transcript dependence, or any automatic routing effect blocks model training.

cost_metric.method: Measure additional elapsed handling effort needed to seal route identity, independent outcome assessment and evidence references for each treatment case.

comparison.unit: natural coding-agent task in the same task-class, risk and repository-context bands

allowed: GitHub pull request and CI evidence
